title: The Beginning of DeFiChain
text: DeFiChain was created to bring decentralized financial services to the Bitcoin ecosystem.

title: Why Bitcoin?
text: DeFiChain chose Bitcoin as its foundation because of its security, decentralization and long-term stability.

title: What is DFI?
text: DFI is the native asset of DeFiChain. It powers governance, staking, liquidity mining and transaction fees.
